'''Alliance Base #16''', also referred to as '''Gaulus base''', was a secret [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gaulus/Legends|Gaulus]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was commanded by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Mehar Grot]], who discovered that a [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]] assigned to their [[Executive officer/Legends|second-in-command]] was, in fact, an [[espionage droid]] who had transmitted the base's location and defenses to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The base was razed by Imperial forces shortly after.
